description: Claude Code adapter ONLY (portable harnesses get no hooks; the same nudges are documented in the autodidact methodology). SessionStart: gardening-overdue nudge from the deterministic thresholds CLI. Stop: capture reminder.

hooks.command: sh -c 'if [ -f docs/knowledge/INDEX.md ]; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/distill/scripts/mechanical.py" thresholds --kb-root docs/knowledge >/dev/null 2>&1; if [ $? -eq 4 ]; then echo "autodidact-learning: KB gardening thresholds hit - run the distill skill at the next natural boundary"; fi; fi; exit 0'

sh -c 'if [ -f docs/knowledge/INDEX.md ]; then echo "autodidact-learning: if this session produced learnings (gate decisions, corrections, good answers), file them with the capture skill before closing"; fi; exit 0'
